name: chatroom
description: One room where Claude Code, Codex and the GitHub Copilot CLI work together with their own tools, skills and sessions, plus Ollama. Agents discuss, hand off with @mentions and work as a team.

commands.title: Chatroom: Sign in to Copilot CLI

chatroom.codexPath.description: Codex executable or CLI JavaScript file. Default prefers the installed Codex extension runtime, then PATH. Uses your existing login.

chatroom.claudePath.description: Claude executable or CLI JavaScript file. Default prefers the installed Claude Code extension runtime, then PATH. Uses your existing login.

chatroom.copilotPath.description: Copilot CLI executable. The default looks on PATH (npm or WinGet install).

chatroom.modelDefaults.description: Model IDs by task preset and provider (codex, claude, copilot, ollama). Configure with Chatroom's Settings button. Empty values choose from the discovered client catalog; drafting prefers a small model when available.

chatroom.defaultPreset.description: Task preset for new rooms. Planning also covers orchestration. Switching a room's preset applies its models to all agents.

enumDescriptions: Team: the lead answers or brings in teammates with @mentions or a step plan; independent steps run in parallel and the lead writes the final answer.
Relay: agents reply one after another, each building on the replies before it.
Parallel: agents answer independently with the same context; the next round sees all replies.
chatroom.executionMode.description: How agents collaborate in new rooms. @mentioning agents in a message always sends it to just those agents.

chatroom.maxParallelAgents.description: Maximum agents (or Team steps) running at once. Agents with Auto-edit or Full access still edit one at a time.

enumDescriptions: Ask: agents ask before edits and commands, with approval cards in the room.
Auto-edit: agents edit files freely and ask for everything else.
Full access: no approvals. Only used when chatroom.allowFullAccess is on.
chatroom.defaultPermission.description: Permission level for new agents. `full` is only used when `chatroom.allowFullAccess` is on. User settings only: a workspace cannot set it.

chatroom.allowFullAccess.description: Allow choosing Full access (no approvals) for agents. User settings only: a workspace cannot set it.

chatroom.approvalTimeoutSeconds.description: Unanswered approval requests are denied after this time.

chatroom.attachOpenFile.description: Share the file open in the editor (and your selection) with agents. You can turn it off per room with the eye button.

chatroom.shareSkills.description: Share skills between Claude Code, Codex and Copilot in new rooms.

chatroom.sharedMcpServers.description: MCP servers given to every native agent, in Claude's `.mcp.json` format: `{"name":{"command":"…","args":[]}}` or `{"name":{"type":"http","url":"…"}}`. User settings only: a workspace cannot add servers. Names starting with `chatroom` are reserved.

chatroom.idleSessionMinutes.description: Stop an agent's CLI process after this much idle time. Its session resumes on the next turn.

chatroom.copilotUseEnvToken.description: Pass GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN to the Copilot CLI. Off by default because a classic token in your environment breaks Copilot sign-in.

chatroom.ollamaUrl.description: Ollama endpoint. Only loopback endpoints are supported.

chatroom.contextTokens.description: Approximate room history budget: what a new agent session receives once, and what Ollama and VS Code chat models receive every turn.

chatroom.turnTimeoutSeconds.description: Stop an agent's turn after this many seconds without any activity. Time spent waiting for your approval does not count.

chatroom.ollamaKeepAlive.description: How long Ollama keeps a model loaded after a request.

scripts.package: npm run check && npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --out artifacts/chatroom-0.4.0.vsix
